title: Align native-wait status hints with the own-run completion route
outcome: Registration receipts and summaries consistently distinguish registration eligibility from an installed host wait, and direct a root session to its supported own-run route.
acceptance: Foreground and different-session registration status no longer recommends a self-send; registration-only wait eligibility is described consistently.
Unavailable and unconfirmed host-wait states render consistently in registration and host-wait lines, with focused assertions covering the wording.
